name: Per-Query Retriever Router
mechanism: Selects sparse, dense, hybrid or bounded fan-out retrieval per query using explicit query features and a logged fallback policy.
use_when: Query classes have measurably different winning retrievers
Route decisions and oracle-route gaps can be evaluated
avoid_when: A wrong route can hide critical evidence without fallback
expected_effects: Better matching of exact and semantic query classes
failure_modes: Hidden fan-out cost exceeds the static baseline
required_evals: p95 latency and cost by route
